name: Destroy Identity (d20pfsrd)
body:
You are able to use your weapons to destroy some of your opponent’s most distinctive physical characteristics.

Prerequisites: Critical Focus, base attack bonus +11, worshiper of an evil god.

Benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit against an opponent, the target is so maimed that it takes 2 points of Charisma damage and becomes staggered for 1 round.
